title: Kissed Rich Peruvian Potato Wrap
description: A rich and pillowy post-workout Peruvian dish featuring melted butter and ssam-wrap, vegan-friendly by using vegan butter substitute. This dish is perfect for a snack or light meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the sliced potatoes with olive oil, salt, black pepper, and paprika until they are evenly coated.
Spread the potatoes out in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast for 20 minutes, or until they are tender and lightly browned.
While the potatoes are roasting, melt the vegan butter substitute in a small saucepan over low heat.
Once the potatoes are done, remove them from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes.
To assemble the wraps, lay a sheet of ssam wrap flat on a work surface and arrange a few slices of the roasted potatoes in the center of the wrap.
Drizzle the melted vegan butter substitute over the potatoes and sprinkle with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
Fold the bottom edge of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap up tightly to form a neat package.
Serve the wraps warm, with additional melted vegan butter substitute on the side if desired.
